body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 6 units. On a success, restrain its movement; it cannot voluntarily move more than 2 units until its next turn ends.

surges.html: Mark one affected creature; your next Psionics Action against it gains 1 free Surge, then remove the mark.
Gain +1 Defense against the next Action that targets you before your next turn.

rider.title: PROJECTION — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the target also burns 1 die if it attempts to move before its next turn.
